description: One-call check to onboard a customer or supplier (KYB): verifies that the company exists and is operating, that the legal name you were given matches (name), that the signer is a current director or sole shareholder (person) and, if requested, the EU VAT number in VIES (vat). Returns fail if the Spanish Tax Agency has revoked its tax ID (flag TAX_ID_REVOKED). Returns flags and a pass / review / fail recommendation, plus legal form, LEI, parent company and sole shareholder. Use it to make a decision; to just look up data, use get_company. Pro plan; uses 2 requests. Verificación KYB de una empresa española.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834 (spaces and hyphens are accepted)

name.description: Legal name declared by the customer, to check that it matches

person.description: Name of the person signing, to check whether they are a director or the sole shareholder

vat.description: true to also check the EU VAT number in VIES (intra-EU trader)

name: verify_company
title: KYB verification of a Spanish company
